title: Solving Quantified Modal Logic Problems by Translation to Classical Logics
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Automated Theorem Proving (ATP) systems for modal logic problems. While it mentions applications in 'theoretical philosophy' and 'epistemic logics', these are domains where modal logic is applied, not an evaluation or benchmarking of the ATP systems on faith, ethics, or morals in a normative or interpretative sense. The evaluation is purely on the logical reasoning capabilities of the systems.
